personality_one_liner: A calm, non-intrusive parental dashboard for child digital wellbeing, blending soft botanical tones with crisp iOS-native readability.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a calm, uncluttered experience. Padding is carefully maintained on all containers to ensure a soft and airy feel.

do's: Use subtle glass effects on sticky tab bars and full-screen overlay backgrounds to maintain a soft, premium aesthetic.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur on content cards or text backgrounds.

screens.name: Dashboard Principal
screens.purpose: A calm overview showing current active status, daily screen time, and sensory load index.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with subtle shimmer on the dashboard grid.
states.empty: N/A - the dashboard always shows some data or default baseline metrics.
states.error: Soft retry prompt card below the ambient shield badge.

screens.layout: Header with 'Quick-Child' pill left and 'Shield Active' breathing badge right. Main column features: 1. A soft banner showing 'Protected' ambient state. 2. A circular/bar chart card for 'Daily Screen Time'. 3. A smooth wave chart card for 'Sensory Load Index'. 4. A 'Quick Actions' horizontal row at the bottom.

screens.name: Alerts & Gentle Interventions
screens.purpose: A non-alarmist feed grouping sensory spikes and soft interventions into a digestible daily digest.

states.empty: Illustration of a peaceful plant with 'All is calm today. No interventions needed.'
states.error: Gentle error message with a 'Refresh' button.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with a 'Clear All' button. Below, a scrollable list grouped by 'TODAY'. Each item is a card containing a status pill ('Auto-Interruption' in Soft Terracotta or 'Attention Transition' in Butter Gold), a short description, and an action button.

screens.name: AI Explicativo Cards
screens.purpose: Explain the 'Why' behind AI-approved or blocked content focusing on cognitive stimulus.

states.error: Failed to load details. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: A detailed view showing a video thumbnail at the top. Below the image: title, duration, pacing stats. Following that, a horizontally scrollable chip row of 'Cognitive Stimulus Verified' badges, and a readable 'Why AI Approved This' explanation paragraph.

screens.name: Slow Content Library
screens.purpose: A curated library of age-appropriate, low-stimulus content.

states.empty: Illustration of an open book with 'No content found for this filter.'

screens.layout: A sticky horizontal chip row for age filtering at the top. Below, a 2-column or full-width vertical list of content cards (e.g., 'Forest Tales', 'Little Woodworker'). Each card displays an image, cuts/minute metric, audio notes, and an '[+ Add to Allowed List]' button.

screens.name: Weekly Cognitive Health Summary
screens.purpose: An aggregate weekly report highlighting balanced cognitive behavior and offline activities.

states.empty: Not enough data collected yet. Check back on Sunday.

screens.layout: A scrollable view featuring large metric typography. Sections include 'Total Screen Hours', 'Sensory Overload Prevented' (spikes count), and 'Cognitive Balance Score'. Concludes with a list of 'Recommended Offline Activities' and a prominent button to 'Schedule Offline Reminder'.

screens.name: Soft Landing Overlay (12s)
screens.purpose: A demoable, full-screen child interruption experience featuring a breathing transition to lower sensory load.
screens.layout: A full-screen, translucent view with an ambient breathing animation (4s cycle pulse) at the center. Saturated colors gently cool down over 12 seconds, inviting a pause before transitioning to the next screen.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the parent to the Cognitive Shield concepts and handle JWT authentication.

states.error: Inline text message for login failure.

screens.layout: 3-step full-screen swipeable 'Cognitive Shield' tour (Filter, Vault, Guard), ending with a clean email/password login/signup form anchored by a primary 'Teal Nature' CTA.

soft_landing_bg.alt: Mother and child practicing yoga poses calmly

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the exact color tokens, typography scale, and layout descriptions provided. Do not invent new colors, especially avoiding generic blues/purples.
Implement the custom shadow specification `0px 8px 24px rgba(20,92,104,0.06)` for all cards to create the required soft elevation.
Ensure the 'Soft Landing' overlay utilizes a smooth 350ms ease-in-out transition and features a 4s breathing pulse animation without any alarming or sudden visual changes.
Apply 18px radii for cards, 12px for buttons, and 999px for pills/badges.
For the Parent Dashboard, ensure the 'Quick-Child' pill and 'Shield Active' status remain anchored at the top for immediate context switching without deep menu navigation.
